source_location: Private source log retained outside this repository; not included.
allowed_records: Only user visible text, or assistant visible commentary/final answers.
hash_spec: original_visible_message_sha256 = SHA256(UTF8 of original visible text blocks joined with one LF, without normalization). excerpt_sha256 = SHA256(UTF8 exact excerpt). excerpt_offsets_codepoints uses Python Unicode codepoint indices [start,end) within the original visible text.
excerpt_policy: Exact contiguous source substrings from the prior curated export. Multiple spans of one original message remain separate. Omitted prefixes/suffixes are explicit; editorial summaries are labeled non-verbatim.

public_transformation.input: Previously verified project-specific curated visible-message collection; no raw log read for this public packaging step.
removed_metadata: source log size and filesystem timestamps
public_transformation.replacement_metadata: message_ref and chronology_index are newly assigned within this selected collection in original source order. They are not original platform IDs.
public_transformation.verification: All excerpt strings compared exactly with the existing curated JSONL; all 29 excerpt hashes recomputed successfully. Original full-message hashes and offset correspondence were verified during original extraction, not rederived from a full private log during public packaging.

publication_note: This directory contains the public-ready selection. It does not contain a full conversation export or a new claim that historical statements are measurements.
